title: INDONESIA TRAVEL VLOG
content:
INDONESIA TRAVEL VLOG

Made with Seedance 2.5

Beautiful young woman. Preserve her exact face, identity, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions throughout.

Raw, spontaneous flip-camera footage: natural shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, soft image, warm faded colors, digital noise, compression, motion blur. No cinematic polish, stabilization, beauty filters, or modern grading.

00:00–00:04- Walks through an Indonesian village and smiles at camera.
“Okay, let’s find some real Indonesian breakfast!”

00:04–00:08- Explores a small local market and watches a vendor prepare steaming traditional food.
“Everything smells amazing.”

00:08–00:12- Tries a banana-leaf-wrapped snack and reacts happily.
“Oh wow... I actually love this!”

00:12–00:16- Eats with local villagers, copies them, makes a small mistake, and everyone laughs naturally.

00:16–00:20- Learns to prepare a traditional snack, makes it messy, and laughs.
“Yeah... I definitely need some practice.”

00:20–00:24- Walks through the village, waves to shy children, and continues naturally.

00:24–00:27-Stops on a small wooden bridge surrounded by tropical greenery. Natural birds, insects, and flowing water.
“I could stay here all day.”

00:27–00:30- Walks away, turns back, waves playfully.
“Okay, breakfast mission successful. See you!”

AUDIO: Natural village sounds only. No background music.

NEGATIVE: No cinematic shots, drone, gimbal, slow motion, glamour lighting, perfect framing, artificial acting, face/identity drift, outfit or hairstyle changes, subtitles, captions, logos, or watermarks.

FINAL FEEL: A genuine, imperfect personal vacation video filmed by a friend in an Indonesian village around 2008–2009.

es.content:
VLOG DE VIAJE A INDONESIA

Hecho con Seedance 2.5

Hermosa mujer joven. Conserva exactamente su rostro, identidad, peinado, tono de piel y proporciones corporales en todo momento.

Metraje crudo y espontáneo de cámara en mano con flip-camera: vibración natural, encuadre imperfecto, autofocus buscando foco, cambios de exposición, imagen suave, colores cálidos y desvaídos, ruido digital, compresión, motion blur. Sin acabado cinematográfico, sin estabilización, sin filtros de belleza ni color grading moderno.

00:00–00:04- Camina por un pueblo indonesio y sonríe a la cámara.
“Okay, let’s find some real Indonesian breakfast!”

00:04–00:08- Explora un pequeño mercado local y observa a un vendedor preparar comida tradicional humeante.
“Everything smells amazing.”

00:08–00:12- Prueba un snack envuelto en hoja de plátano y reacciona con alegría.
“Oh wow... I actually love this!”

00:12–00:16- Come con aldeanos locales, los imita, comete un pequeño error y todos se ríen de forma natural.

00:16–00:20- Aprende a preparar un snack tradicional, lo hace de forma desordenada y se ríe.
“Yeah... I definitely need some practice.”

00:20–00:24- Camina por el pueblo, saluda a niños tímidos y continúa de forma natural.

00:24–00:27- Se detiene en un pequeño puente de madera rodeado de vegetación tropical. Pájaros, insectos y agua fluyendo de forma natural.
“I could stay here all day.”

00:27–00:30- Se aleja caminando, se gira y saluda con gesto juguetón.
“Okay, breakfast mission successful. See you!”

AUDIO: Solo sonidos naturales del pueblo. Sin música de fondo.

NEGATIVE: No cinematic shots, drone, gimbal, slow motion, glamour lighting, perfect framing, artificial acting, face/identity drift, outfit or hairstyle changes, subtitles, captions, logos, or watermarks.

SENSACIÓN FINAL: Un video de vacaciones personal, genuino e imperfecto, filmado por un amigo en un pueblo indonesio alrededor de 2008–2009.

fr.content:
VLOG DE VOYAGE EN INDONÉSIE

Réalisé avec Seedance 2.5

Belle jeune femme. Conservez exactement son visage, son identité, sa coiffure, son teint et ses proportions corporelles tout au long de la vidéo.

Images brutes, spontanées, filmées en mode flip-camera : tremblements naturels, cadrage imparfait, autofocus qui cherche, variations d’exposition, image douce, couleurs chaudes et délavées, bruit numérique, compression, flou de mouvement. Aucun rendu cinématographique, aucune stabilisation, aucun filtre beauté, ni étalonnage moderne.

00:00–00:04- Marche dans un village indonésien et sourit à la caméra.
« D’accord, trouvons un vrai petit-déjeuner indonésien ! »

00:04–00:08- Explore un petit marché local et regarde un vendeur préparer de la nourriture traditionnelle fumante.
« Tout sent incroyablement bon. »

00:08–00:12- Goûte une collation enveloppée dans une feuille de bananier et réagit avec joie.
« Oh wow... j’adore vraiment ça ! »

00:12–00:16- Mange avec des villageois locaux, les imite, fait une petite erreur, et tout le monde rit naturellement.

00:16–00:20- Apprend à préparer une collation traditionnelle, en met partout, puis rit.
« Ouais... j’ai clairement besoin d’un peu d’entraînement. »

00:20–00:24- Marche dans le village, fait signe à des enfants timides, et continue naturellement.

00:24–00:27- S’arrête sur un petit pont en bois entouré de verdure tropicale. Oiseaux, insectes et eau qui coule naturellement.
« Je pourrais rester ici toute la journée. »

00:27–00:30- S’éloigne, se retourne, fait un signe de la main avec espièglerie.
« Bon, mission petit-déjeuner accomplie. À bientôt ! »

AUDIO : Sons naturels du village uniquement. Pas de musique de fond.

NÉGATIF : Pas de plans cinématographiques, drone, gimbal, ralenti, éclairage glamour, cadrage parfait, jeu d’acteur artificiel, dérive du visage/de l’identité, changements de tenue ou de coiffure, sous-titres, légendes, logos ou filigranes.

SENSATION FINALE : Une vraie vidéo de vacances personnelle, imparfaite, filmée par un ami dans un village indonésien vers 2008–2009.

ja.content:
---
INDONESIA TRAVEL VLOG

Seedance 2.5で制作

美しい若い女性。全編を通して、彼女の顔、アイデンティティ、髪型、肌の色、体型の比率を正確に維持すること。

生々しく、自然発生的なフリップカメラ映像：自然な揺れ、完璧ではないフレーミング、オートフォーカスの迷い、露出の変化、柔らかい画、暖かく色あせた色味、デジタルノイズ、圧縮ノイズ、モーションブラー。cinematicな仕上げ、手ブレ補正、beauty filter、現代的なグレーディングは一切なし。

00:00–00:04- インドネシアの村を歩きながらカメラに笑いかける。
「よし、本場のインドネシアの朝ごはんを探そう！」

00:04–00:08- 小さなローカルマーケットを見て回り、湯気の立つ伝統料理を店主が準備する様子を見る。
「どれもすごくいい匂い。」

00:08–00:12- バナナの葉で包まれたスナックを試し、うれしそうに反応する。
「うわ……これ、ほんとに好きかも！」

00:12–00:16- 地元の村人たちと一緒に食事し、真似をして、小さな失敗をして、みんなが自然に笑う。

00:16–00:20- 伝統的なスナックの作り方を教わり、少し散らかしてしまい、笑う。
「うん……これは、もっと練習が必要だね。」

00:20–00:24- 村の中を歩き、恥ずかしがり屋の子どもたちに手を振り、そのまま自然に進む。

00:24–00:27- 熱帯の緑に囲まれた小さな木の橋の上で立ち止まる。自然の鳥の声、虫の声、水の流れる音。
「一日中ここにいられそう。」

00:27–00:30- 歩き去り、振り返って、いたずらっぽく手を振る。
「よし、朝ごはんミッション成功。またね！」

AUDIO: 自然な村の環境音のみ。BGMなし。

NEGATIVE: cinematic shots、ドローン、ジンバル、スローモーション、グラマラスな照明、完璧なフレーミング、不自然な演技、顔/アイデンティティの変化、服装や髪型の変更、字幕、キャプション、ロゴ、ウォーターマークは一切なし。

FINAL FEEL: 2008〜2009年頃のインドネシアの村で、友人が撮影したような、本物で不完全な個人的バケーションビデオ。
---

ko.content:
인도네시아 여행 브이로그

Seedance 2.5로 제작

아름다운 젊은 여성. 전체 영상에서 그녀의 정확한 얼굴, 정체성, 헤어스타일, 피부 톤, 체형 비율을 그대로 유지할 것.

날것 그대로의 즉흥적인 플립카메라 영상: 자연스러운 흔들림, 불완전한 구도, 오토포커스 헌팅, 노출 변화, 부드러운 화질, 따뜻하게 바랜 색감, 디지털 노이즈, 압축 흔적, 모션 블러. 시네마틱한 보정, 안정화, 뷰티 필터, 현대적인 그레이딩은 없음.

00:00–00:04- 인도네시아 마을을 걸으며 카메라를 향해 미소 짓는다.
“Okay, let’s find some real Indonesian breakfast!”

00:04–00:08- 작은 현지 시장을 둘러보고, 상인이 김이 나는 전통 음식을 준비하는 모습을 지켜본다.
“Everything smells amazing.”

00:08–00:12- 바나나잎에 싸인 간식을 먹어보고 기쁘게 반응한다.
“Oh wow... I actually love this!”

00:12–00:16- 현지 마을 사람들과 함께 식사하며 그들을 따라 해 보고, 작은 실수를 하자 모두가 자연스럽게 웃는다.

00:16–00:20- 전통 간식 만드는 법을 배우지만 엉망으로 만들고, 웃는다.
“Yeah... I definitely need some practice.”

00:20–00:24- 마을을 걸으며 수줍어하는 아이들에게 손을 흔들고, 자연스럽게 계속 걸어간다.

00:24–00:27- 열대 식물로 둘러싸인 작은 나무 다리 위에서 멈춰 선다. 자연스러운 새소리, 벌레 소리, 흐르는 물소리.
“I could stay here all day.”

00:27–00:30- 걸어가다가 뒤돌아보며 장난스럽게 손을 흔든다.
“Okay, breakfast mission successful. See you!”

AUDIO: 배경음악 없이 자연스러운 마을 소리만.

NEGATIVE: 시네마틱 샷, 드론, 짐벌, 슬로모션, 글래머 조명, 완벽한 구도, 인위적인 연기, 얼굴/정체성 드리프트, 의상 또는 헤어스타일 변화, 자막, 캡션, 로고, 워터마크 없음.

FINAL FEEL: 2008–2009년경 인도네시아 마을에서 친구가 촬영한 듯한, 진짜 같고 완벽하지 않은 개인 여행 영상.

pt.content:
VLOG DE VIAGEM À INDONÉSIA

Feito com Seedance 2.5

Jovem mulher bonita. Preserve exatamente seu rosto, identidade, penteado, tom de pele e proporções corporais ao longo de todo o vídeo.

Filmagem crua e espontânea com câmera flip: tremor natural, enquadramento imperfeito, autofocus “caçando”, variações de exposição, imagem suave, cores quentes e desbotadas, ruído digital, compressão, motion blur. Sem acabamento cinematográfico, estabilização, filtros de beleza ou color grading moderno.

00:00–00:04- Caminha por uma vila indonésia e sorri para a câmera.
“Ok, vamos encontrar um café da manhã indonésio de verdade!”

00:04–00:08- Explora um pequeno mercado local e observa um vendedor preparar comida tradicional fumegante.
“Tudo tem um cheiro incrível.”

00:08–00:12- Experimenta um lanche embrulhado em folha de bananeira e reage feliz.
“Uau... eu realmente adorei isso!”

00:12–00:16- Come com moradores locais, os imita, comete um pequeno erro e todos riem naturalmente.

00:16–00:20- Aprende a preparar um lanche tradicional, faz uma bagunça e ri.
“É... eu definitivamente preciso praticar um pouco.”

00:20–00:24- Caminha pela vila, acena para crianças tímidas e continua naturalmente.

00:24–00:27- Para em uma pequena ponte de madeira cercada por vegetação tropical. Pássaros, insetos e água corrente naturais.
“Eu poderia ficar aqui o dia todo.”

00:27–00:30- Vai embora, olha para trás e acena de forma brincalhona.
“Ok, missão café da manhã cumprida. Até mais!”

ÁUDIO: Apenas sons naturais da vila. Sem música de fundo.

NEGATIVE: No cinematic shots, drone, gimbal, slow motion, glamour lighting, perfect framing, artificial acting, face/identity drift, outfit or hairstyle changes, subtitles, captions, logos, or watermarks.

SENSAÇÃO FINAL: Um vídeo de férias pessoal, genuíno e imperfeito, filmado por um amigo em uma vila indonésia por volta de 2008–2009.

zh.content:
印度尼西亚旅行 vlog

使用 Seedance 2.5 制作

美丽的年轻女性。全程保持她完全一致的面容、身份、发型、肤色和身体比例。

原始、即兴的翻转相机画面：自然抖动、构图不完美、自动对焦来回拉风、曝光变化、画面柔和、温暖褪色的色彩、数字噪点、压缩痕迹、运动模糊。不要 cinematic 修饰、稳定器、美颜滤镜或现代调色。

00:00–00:04- 走过印度尼西亚村庄，对着镜头微笑。
“Okay, let’s find some real Indonesian breakfast!”

00:04–00:08- 探索一个当地小市场，看着摊贩准备热气腾腾的传统食物。
“Everything smells amazing.”

00:08–00:12- 尝试一种用香蕉叶包裹的小吃，并开心地做出反应。
“Oh wow... I actually love this!”

00:12–00:16- 和当地村民一起吃饭，模仿他们，犯了一个小错误，大家自然地笑了起来。

00:16–00:20- 学着制作一种传统小吃，弄得一团糟，然后笑了。
“Yeah... I definitely need some practice.”

00:20–00:24- 走过村庄，向害羞的孩子们挥手，然后自然地继续前行。

00:24–00:27- 停在一座被热带绿植环绕的小木桥上。自然的鸟鸣、昆虫声和流水声。
“I could stay here all day.”

00:27–00:30- 走开后又回头，俏皮地挥手。
“Okay, breakfast mission successful. See you!”

AUDIO: 仅保留自然的村庄环境音。不要背景音乐。

NEGATIVE: 不要 cinematic 镜头、无人机、稳定器、慢动作、柔光美颜、完美构图、人工表演、面容/身份漂移、服装或发型变化、字幕、说明文字、logo 或水印。

FINAL FEEL: 一段真实、略显不完美的个人度假视频，像是 2008–2009 年间由朋友在印度尼西亚村庄拍摄的。
